title: The Case Against Cutting Social Security: Kathryn Anne Edwards
description:
Bloomberg Opinion's Kathryn Anne Edwards joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Money." Edwards writes that for the last 43 years Social Security has been on autopilot, and makes the case for modernizing the program to meet 2026 economic issues.
